subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should typed create and full replacement persist explicit announce delivery for `current` and named-session jobs to match existing runtime behavior?
rationale: The patch is correct and consistent, but it intentionally changes serialized output for existing typed inputs, which requires maintainer acceptance of the compatibility effect.

options.title: Accept aligned serialization
options.body: Merge after required checks pass because explicit announce makes typed operations match established normalization and runtime behavior.

options.title: Preserve omission semantics
options.body: Pause only if a supported typed consumer is identified that intentionally distinguishes omitted delivery from explicit announce.

recommendation.title: Accept aligned serialization
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks pass because explicit announce makes typed operations match established normalization and runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They established and merged the current persistent-session target contract that governs this compatibility choice.
